name: tcf-label-change
description: HubSpot integration tool with a local web UI
author: TCF

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:bundle && npm run build:electron && electron-builder
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run build:bundle && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run build:bundle && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -n dev,electron -c cyan,green "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run start -w server
